scope: Frozen 2dd302d integration: verified pull then skill synchronization/check before model launch, stage receipts, conflict preservation and canonical output scope. Raw full-suite execution accounting only; no general correctness or model/performance claim.

implementation.procedure: Check frozen sources and AST call order independently
implementation.acceptance: prepare_host precedes Popen; git verification precedes skill sync; --check and phase receipts retained

reference_boundary.procedure: Run real Git and installer boundary fixtures in separate host process
reference_boundary.acceptance: All runner/installer checks pass, including unpublished/local-edit/check-failure/canonical/human-guide cases

data_integrity.procedure: Parse raw verbose logs and hash-bind artifacts
data_integrity.acceptance: Unique case IDs equal totals, skip denominator explicit; all command receipts successful

numerical_sanity.procedure: Check finite counts and elapsed values
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Counts integral, elapsed finite positive, summaries match raw IDs

measurement_validity.acceptance: No performance/scientific/model claim; timing validity explicitly N/A

reproducibility.procedure: Rerun focused fixtures on actual frozen source
reproducibility.acceptance: Separate runner/installer runs succeed; current source matches snapshots
